name: Swordfish
lore: A narrow hull that is all launch rack. Its cells hold racks of unguided rockets, rippled out by the dozen onto a stretch of shore or a knot of ships. Point defence takes them one at a time; there are too many to take them all. It has nothing else.

weapons.name: Dumbfire Rockets
weapons.lore: Thirty-two unguided rockets a salvo out of eight canted cells, lobbed high and falling over and round the mark.
